purpose: Existing compiled classes retained after runtime dependency cache loss; last successful export low05 used same classes; no engine/integration source edits since then.
validation_scope: Records identity of retained compiled output used for the headless recovery. Does not claim that a clean independent recompilation was performed or will produce identical bytes.

tree_definition.order: Sort relative POSIX paths by their UTF-8 bytes (ascending).
tree_definition.line_format: lowercase_sha256 + two ASCII spaces + relative_POSIX_path + LF
tree_definition.tree_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 encoding of the concatenated lines; include one LF after every entry including the last.
tree_definition.scope: All regular files recursively under the stated root, including Kotlin module metadata. No mtimes or absolute paths enter the digest.

legacy_record.status: Historical aggregate retained; its original aggregation algorithm was not recorded. Use the v2 file inventory and explicit tree definition for independent recomputation.
